Online Bidding: https://teamlorraine.ie/property/keelogue-maynooth-road-celbridge-co-kildare-w23-tx04/

Keelogue, Maynooth Road, Celbridge, Co. Kildare, W23 TX04.

C. 280.77 sqm C3,020 sq ft 
B1 BER Rating 
Circa 2006 

Team Lorraine Mulligan of RE/MAX Results proud recipients of the `Circle of Legends` award and honoured Auctioneers for the past 23 consecutive years are delighted to present `Keelogue` to the market. This is, without question, one of the most remarkable family homes to come to the market in this area in recent years, and we are truly privileged to have the honour of offering it for sale.

A HOME OF RARE DISTINCTION
There are properties that simply sell themselves and then there is `Keelogue`. The moment you arrive, you sense something wonderfully different about this home. It radiates warmth, character and an almost palpable sense of happiness the kind of atmosphere that can only be created by a family who have truly loved where they live. Owned with evident pride by a couple of impeccable taste and sensibility, every corner of this magnificent residence has been thoughtfully maintained and beautifully presented, ready to welcome its next fortunate custodians.
Extending to an impressive C. 3,020 square feet and enjoying a coveted B1 BER energy rating, `Keelogue` is a home of extraordinary substance. It sits elegantly on its own private site a particularly special feature being the original stone wall of the historic Castletown Estate, which forms a magnificent and truly irreplaceable backdrop to the manicured rear garden. This is not merely a house; it is a home of genuine heritage and distinction.

EXCEPTIONAL DESIGN. OUTSTANDING QUALITY.
The layout of `Keelogue` is a testament to inspired, family-centred design. Conceived with a mother`s instinct and a professional`s eye for detail, every room has been positioned with both practicality and pleasure in mind. With the current owners having a background in the building trade, the quality of construction throughout is simply superb far beyond what one typically encounters in even the most prestigious of family homes.
The result is a home that is as functional as it is beautiful; as practical as it is impressive. Whether you are raising a young family, welcoming extended family, or simply seeking a home of space and splendour in which to put down deep roots, `Keelogue` delivers on every front with effortless grace.

A RARE B1 ENERGY RATING GREEN MORTGAGE ELIGIBLE
In today`s market, energy efficiency is not merely desirable it is essential. `Keelogue` achieves an outstanding B1 BER rating of 99.66 kWh/m²/yr, with a potential to reach A2 standard. This exceptional rating means that qualifying purchasers may be eligible for a Green Mortgage, benefiting from reduced interest rates and lower monthly repayments a considerable financial advantage in addition to the joys of owning such a magnificent home. Running costs are substantially reduced, and the environmental credentials of this property are second to none.

A Personal Note from Team Lorraine Mulligan
In more than two decades of selling some of the finest homes in County Kildare, it is a genuine privilege to present a home as truly special as `Keelogue.` From the moment one crosses the threshold, there is a warmth and a happiness to this home that is immediately and unmistakably felt. This is a home that has been lived in and loved and it shows in every detail, every room, and every beautifully tended corner of its wonderful gardens.
Properties of this calibre, in this condition, at this address, are extraordinarily rare. We anticipate considerable interest from discerning buyers, and we would strongly encourage early viewing. Seeing truly is believing and `Keelogue` will not disappoint.

INTEREST IS CERTAIN TO BE SIGNIFICANT.
EARLY VIEWING IS STRONGLY ADVISED.

To organize a viewing or to place a bid go the property listing on www.teamlorraine.ie or scan the QR code on the photograph section of this brochure.

GROUND FLOOR ACCOMMODATION
Step through the magnificent composite front door and you are immediately struck by the grandeur of this entrance. The L-shaped hallway is a statement of intent generous, gracious, and beautifully finished with rich solid hardwood flooring, elegant coving, a decorative centre rose, and a sweeping staircase adorned with a stunning balustrade. This entrance hall alone sets the tone for everything that follows.

Entrance Hallway L-Shaped: 8.74m x 4.89m
Features: Composite front door, alarm panel, coving, centre rose, under-stair storage closet, stunning solid hardwood flooring, carpeted stairwell with elegant balustrade.

At the heart of `Keelogue` lies a truly spectacular open-plan kitchen, dining and living area the kind of space that forms the warm and beating centre of every wonderful family home. Flooded with natural light and configured in a generous L-shape, this magnificent room seamlessly combines every facet of modern family life: cooking, dining, entertaining and relaxing together. A substantial island unit provides ample space for informal dining and social gathering, while a solid-fuel stove lends the living area a cosy, convivial warmth on winter evenings. Double doors lead directly to the rear garden and patio, while internal double doors connect beautifully to the grand sitting room beyond.

Kitchen / Dining / Living Area L-Shaped: 7.54m x 7.50m
Features: Coving, chrome recessed lighting, Range Master` cooker with gas hob and dual electric ovens, matching extractor hood, quality fitted kitchen with extensive wall and base units, wine rack, crystal display cabinet, fully plumbed, integrated dishwasher, integrated fridge-freezer, large island unit with storage and seating, marble feature fireplace with solid-fuel stove, window blinds, French double doors to garden, hardwood flooring, internal double doors to sitting room.

The grand sitting room is a room of genuine elegance and refinement a space for quiet evenings, cherished conversation and gracious entertaining. A magnificent marble fireplace commands the room with quiet authority, while the solid hardwood flooring and thoughtful proportions create an atmosphere of timeless sophistication.

Utility Room:
Features: Fully plumbed, fitted wall and floor units with generous worktop, floor tiles, alarm panel, and rear door to garden. A supremely practical space, beautifully organised.

One of the truly rare and distinctive features of `Keelogue` is the provision of a generous master bedroom suite on the ground floor an arrangement of exceptional versatility and practicality. Whether for a family member who prefers single-storey living, an elderly parent, or simply as an additional guest suite, this self-contained accommodation is both luxurious and entirely private.

Ground Floor Master Bedroom: 4.40m x 4.16m
Features: Recessed lighting, beautiful bay window, curtains, blind, and carpet.

Walk-In Wardrobe: 2.06m x 1.90m
Features: Fitted shelving, bespoke fitted storage, fitted wardrobes, radiator, hardwood flooring.

En Suite: 2.21m x 1.72m
Features: Fully tiled walls and floor, W.C., W.H.B., Triton electric shower with glass doors, heated towel rail, extractor fan.

A beautifully appointed family bathroom on the ground floor features a statement corner Jacuzzi bath a luxurious touch that transforms the everyday into something rather special.

Ground Floor Family Bathroom: 2.85m x 2.03m
Features: Chrome recessed lighting, fully tiled walls and floor, W.C., W.H.B., corner Jacuzzi bath, shower over bath, extractor fan.

Bedroom 2 / Home Office / Playroom / Gym: 5.06m x 2.90m
Features: This wonderfully flexible room adapts to your family`s needs currently used as a multi-purpose space, it would serve equally well as a home office, additional bedroom, children`s playroom or dedicated home gym. Light fitting, blinds, curtains, hardwood flooring.


FIRST FLOOR ACCOMMODATION
Ascending the sweeping staircase to the upper floor, one is immediately greeted by a landing of quite exceptional proportions light-filled, generous and beautifully finished. Four large double bedrooms radiate from this wonderful space, each offering impressive dimensions, excellent storage and an abundance of natural light.

Landing: 7.10m x 4.37m
Features: Centre rose, light fitting, chrome recessed lighting, Velux roof window, blackout blinds, curtains, carpet, hot press with an immersion and side storage. A landing of truly impressive scale a perfect introduction to the upper floor.

Bedroom 3: 5.54m x 3.32m
Features: Light fitting, chrome recessed lighting, blackout blind, curtains, fitted wardrobes, shelving units, side storage, carpet.

En Suite (to Bedroom 3): 1.96m x 1.69m
Features: Fully tiled walls and floor, W.C., W.H.B., Triton T90SI electric shower with glass doors, heated towel rail, wall light.

Bedroom 4: 4.72m x 4.44m
Features: Light fitting, beautiful bay window, chrome recessed lighting, blackout blinds, curtains, carpet, side storage. A particularly bright and characterful room.

Bedroom 5: 6.58m x 4.40m
Features: Chrome recessed lighting, fitted wardrobes, blackout blinds, curtains, carpet. A truly generous double bedroom of impressive proportions.

Bedroom 6: 4.46m x 3.70m
Features: Light fitting, fitted wardrobe, blackout blind, curtains, carpet, side storage.

The upper floor bathroom is both spacious and beautifully appointed, featuring a sunken bath and a separate corner shower a combination that brings a genuine sense of spa-like indulgence to the home.

First Floor Family Bathroom: 3.16m x 2.85m
Features: Chrome recessed lighting, fully tiled walls and floor, W.C., W.H.B., sunken bath, separate corner shower with Triton T90 electric shower and glass doors, heated towel rail.

Please note: The roof pitch of `Keelogue` is ideally suited to an attic conversion, offering the potential to create a further three or more additional rooms, subject to the relevant planning permission an exciting prospect for any growing family.


GARDENS, GROUNDS & EXCEPTIONAL PARKING
The exterior of `Keelogue` is every bit as impressive as its interior. To the front, a handsome tarmac driveway with gated entrance accommodating up to ten vehicles is framed by mature hedging and beautifully maintained raised flower beds. This is a home that presents itself with quiet dignity from the moment you arrive.
To the rear, the garden is a triumph of considered design: a generous stone patio area for alfresco dining and entertaining, a fresh lawned area, and as the crowning glory the magnificent original stone wall of the Castletown Estate as an incomparable natural boundary. Peaceful, private and utterly beautiful.
A large double detached garage to the rear offers endless possibilities secure car storage, a professional workshop, a home gym, an artist`s studio, or a future annexe or granny flat, subject to the appropriate planning consents. The mature east-facing garden enjoys the morning sun, making it a wonderfully pleasant place to begin the day.


AN ADDRESS OF ENVIABLE CONVENIENCE
`Keelogue` is positioned on the Dublin side of Celbridge, offering swift and straightforward access to the M4 interchange and onwards to the M50 motorway a commuter`s dream. The Hazelhatch Train Station feeder bus runs directly from outside the property, while excellent bus services connect this address with Dublin city centre, Maynooth and the wider region.
For families, the location is simply outstanding. Children may walk to local schools in complete safety, while those attending Maynooth University or Dublin city campuses are particularly well served by the local transport links. All of life`s daily essentials are within easy reach: Aldi, Tesco and Lidl are all nearby, as are local schools, sports facilities, and the charming and vibrant village of Celbridge with its many fine amenities. The world-renowned Castletown Estate, one of Ireland`s finest Georgian houses and its magnificent parklands, is a short stroll away.


VERSATILITY BEYOND COMPARE
`Keelogue` is one of those exceptional properties that adapts effortlessly to the needs of its owners, whatever those needs may be. It presents outstanding potential across a range of possibilities:
 The perfect family home for a growing family seeking space, quality and an exceptional location.
 An ideal multi-generational residence, offering independent accommodation for an elderly parent or adult children.
 A superb investment opportunity under the Rent-a-Room Scheme, generating up to 14,000 tax-free annually, with strong demand from Intel and Maynooth University communities.
 A wonderful guest house or bed and breakfast, capitalising on the property`s impressive proportions and magnificent presentation.
